name: codex-loop
description: Autonomous issue-to-PR loop for OpenAI Codex: $loop-init sets up a repo (AGENTS.md rules, skills, hooks, trigger/converge/sweep GitHub Actions, labels). Label an issue codex-build and Codex implements, converges CI + reviews, and hands you a ready PR.

interface.shortDescription: Turn approved GitHub issues into reviewed PRs
interface.longDescription: Installs an issue-to-PR loop with repository rules, verification skills, safety hooks, GitHub triggers, convergence, and recovery scaffolding.
defaultPrompt: Set up the Codex issue-to-PR loop in this repo.
Turn this approved plan into a buildable issue.
